gen-irish-grover-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru draws lowercase that nearly touches the ascender line, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Hind Mysuru's best trait is that steadiness, leaving Irish Grover's softly swelling, sturdy letters to supply the fun.
gen-irish-grover-gf-hind-vadodara: Fun and sturdy, Irish Grover leads with softly varied strokes. Hind Vadodara then keeps every line at a constant thickness with spacious, open-looking e and a, so pages of text would glide along without snagging.
gen-irish-grover-gf-liter: Fun and organic, Irish Grover shows only a restrained gap between stem and connecting stroke. Liter, a plain sans with no thick-thin swing and wide mouths on round forms, would read steadily page after page.
gen-irish-grover-gf-martel-sans: Irish Grover is the one to lean on for sturdy, tall-lowercase personality, with the restrained thick-thin play of a worn wooden stamp. Martel Sans handles generous openings and a high mean line.
gen-irish-grover-gf-maven-pro: Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase and the soft, steady variation of a lightly tilted nib to every word. Maven Pro, a plain sans, keeps one constant stroke width.
gen-irish-grover-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline is a plain sans drawn with wire-like weight. Irish Grover does the opposite best, letting horizontals sit a notch lighter than its sturdy uprights, while Montserrat Underline keeps breathing counters and oversized lowercase.
gen-irish-grover-gf-mozilla-headline: Chunky, friendly letters: Irish Grover makes words look sturdy and large, with only low-key thick-thin variation. But Mozilla Headline, a sans with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, stays far quieter.
gen-irish-grover-gf-nokora: Sturdy and playful: Irish Grover makes tall, large-looking words with subtle modulation in stroke weight. But Nokora, a sans-serif, runs a thick, dark stripe of lowercase with a wide-open s, which is the real strength here.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Fun and organic, Irish Grover keeps its contrast mild and never stark. Noto Kufi Arabic, a modern sans, matches that restraint with low contrast, a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans: Irish Grover draws tall, sturdy lowercase with a barely tilted calligraphy nib. Noto Sans, a sans-serif, fills most of its letter height with lowercase and leaves a wide-open c, so text stays plain and steady beside it.
